Basic relationship: Elliptic paraboloid: z=x^2/a^2 + y^2/b^2 -> cross section ellipse

Hyperbolic paraboloid: z=x^2/a^2-y^2/b^2 -> Cross section hyperbola
Ruled surface (every point on surface passes a straight line lying wholly on surface)
2 one-parameter families of straigh lines on hyperbolic paraboloid:
\l*z = x/a - y/b, 1/\l = x/a + y/b
\m*z = x/a + y/b, 1/\m = x/a - y/b
